name: OVERTURE PLA @Creality Ender-3 Pro
filament_notes:
OVERTURE manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 50 C for 7 h.
Manufacturer max speed 70 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed kept at the printer profile's 12 mm3/s; the manufacturer's 70 mm/s (6.3 mm3/s) is a print-speed recommendation, not a limit.
Regular PLA. overture3d.com currently sells it as 2 kg / 3 kg spools and as 1 kg spoolless 'PLA Refill' (same spec table: 190-220 C, 25-60 C, 40-70 mm/s, fan on, dry 50 C/7 h); 1 kg cardboard spools remain on Amazon. Density 1.21 g/cm3 and retraction 20-40 mm/s from OVERTURE PLA TDS V5.1 (Aug 2024). Vicat 64.2 C. Gradient (rainbow) version 'PLA Gradient' shares identical settings. 'Fan: turned on' (no % given).
Source: https://overture3d.com/products/overture-pla-3d-printer-filament-1-75mm-3-kg
